mapper.select: SELECT id, assignment_id, submission_no, content, status, submitted_by_user_id, submitted_at, reviewed_by_user_id, reviewed_at, review_comment FROM learn_task_checkin WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY submission_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, assignment_id, submission_no, content, status, submitted_by_user_id, submitted_at, reviewed_by_user_id, reviewed_at, review_comment FROM learn_task_checkin WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY submission_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE learn_task_checkin SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_by_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_at = #{reviewedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE learn_task_checkin SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewed_by_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_comment = NULL, updated_at = #{reviewedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
